name: Command menu
description: A keyboard-first command menu with grouped actions, fuzzy search, and a clear empty state.
scope: Arrow-key navigation, Escape to close, accessible results announcements, and a command callback.

name: Async combobox
description: A searchable choice field that handles delayed results without losing the user's selection.
scope: Debounced queries, loading and error states, keyboard selection, and request cancellation.

name: Inline editor
description: An editable text field with explicit save, cancel, and validation states.
scope: Edit and read modes, optimistic save feedback, Escape to cancel, and focus restoration.

name: Step form
description: A guided form that preserves entered values while moving between steps.
scope: Per-step validation, back navigation, progress announcement, and a final review step.

name: Validation summary
description: A form-error summary that links each issue back to its field.
scope: Field-level errors, summary links, focus management, and screen-reader announcements.

name: Tag editor
description: A compact chip input for adding, removing, and editing a list of labels.
scope: Duplicate prevention, Enter and Backspace behavior, paste handling, and readable selected tags.

name: File drop zone
description: A file picker that explains type and size limits before a file is chosen.
scope: Keyboard file picker, drag-and-drop, size/type feedback, and a removable selection.

name: Verification code
description: A one-time-code input designed for paste, autofill, and mobile keyboards.
scope: Single logical input, numeric mode, paste support, and error and completion states.

name: Date range picker
description: A start-and-end date picker with clear range boundaries and keyboard access.
scope: Calendar navigation, blocked dates, range validation, and localized display.

name: Filter bar
description: A set of removable filters that keeps active criteria easy to scan.
scope: Filter chips, clear-all action, responsive wrapping, and accessible result counts.

name: Navigation drawer
description: A compact-site navigation panel that works with touch and keyboard input.
scope: Open and close controls, focus return, scroll locking, and reduced-motion behavior.

name: Nested menu
description: A multi-level menu that makes depth visible without trapping keyboard users.
scope: Arrow-key movement, submenu open/close rules, outside click, and touch targets.

name: Overflow tabs
description: A tab strip that keeps long labels and narrow screens usable.
scope: Roving focus, active-panel semantics, scroll-into-view, and narrow-screen overflow.

name: Breadcrumb trail
description: A path indicator that remains readable as navigation depth grows.
scope: Current-page announcement, optional collapsed middle segments, and semantic links.

name: Reading outline
description: An in-page outline that tracks the section currently being read.
scope: Heading discovery, active-section tracking, reduced-motion scrolling, and deep links.

name: Pagination controls
description: A compact page navigator with useful first, previous, next, and last states.
scope: Page range ellipsis, disabled states, keyboard labels, and result-count context.

name: Collapsible tree
description: A hierarchical explorer for folders, categories, or document sections.
scope: Nested selection, arrow-key tree navigation, expansion state, and long-label handling.

name: Data table
description: A responsive table for scanning, sorting, and selecting small datasets.
scope: Sortable headers, row selection, empty state, and mobile horizontal scrolling.

name: Virtual list
description: A long-list view intended to stay responsive while only visible rows are rendered.
scope: Stable keyboard focus, measured row heights, loading boundaries, and accessible item counts.

name: Kanban lanes
description: A task board with move controls that do not rely on dragging alone.
scope: Pointer reordering, keyboard move actions, status updates, and an undo path.

name: Activity timeline
description: A chronological feed that groups updates without hiding their timestamps.
scope: Readable time labels, grouped events, load-more state, and semantic ordering.

name: Schedule calendar
description: A monthly schedule that keeps dense event days readable on small screens.
scope: Month navigation, selected-day agenda, overflow summaries, and keyboard date movement.

name: Comparison grid
description: A side-by-side comparison with a layout that survives narrow viewports.
scope: Sticky labels on desktop, stacked rows on mobile, and explicit missing values.

name: Status dashboard
description: A small metrics view that distinguishes normal, delayed, and unavailable data.
scope: Timestamped values, unavailable-data labels, compact charts, and plain-language status.

name: Toast stack
description: Transient notices that remain readable and never block essential controls.
scope: Queueing, dismissal, polite announcements, and persistent action feedback when needed.

name: Action confirmation
description: A focused confirmation dialog for a reversible or destructive action.
scope: Clear action labels, Escape behavior, focus return, and a required confirmation state.

name: Progress steps
description: A task-progress indicator that says what has completed and what remains.
scope: Current-step semantics, completed and blocked states, and compact mobile layout.

name: Notification center
description: An inbox for updates with clear read, unread, and empty states.
scope: Read status, grouping, bulk actions, and a reliable unread count.

name: Repository map
description: A proposed read-only tool that summarizes a repository's folders and entry points.
scope: Bounded file discovery, ignored paths, source citations, and no code execution.

name: Change risk review
description: A proposed assistant that identifies likely impact areas in a pull-request diff.
scope: Diff-size limits, affected-path summary, evidence links, and uncertainty labels.

name: Test gap finder
description: A proposed diff reviewer that highlights changed behavior without nearby tests.
scope: Map changed files to tests, report gaps with paths, and avoid invented coverage claims.

name: Dependency impact
description: A proposed read-only dependency map for spotting consumers of changed modules.
scope: Static import graph, bounded traversal, cycle handling, and explicit unknown edges.

name: License notice check
description: A proposed inventory of declared licenses and bundled attribution files.
scope: Report file-level evidence and missing notices without giving legal conclusions.

name: Documentation freshness
description: A proposed checker for documentation references that no longer match repository files.
scope: Validate local paths and commands against source files; flag ambiguous references for review.

name: API contract diff
description: A proposed comparison of two API schemas with emphasis on breaking changes.
scope: Schema-size limits, route/field changes, citations, and versioned output.

name: Accessibility review
description: A proposed checklist assistant that ties UI findings to observable markup.
scope: Evidence from supplied HTML, keyboard-flow checklist, and no claim of a full audit.

name: Release checklist
description: A proposed release checklist assembled from repository configuration and changes.
scope: Read-only evidence, human sign-off steps, and explicit unverified checks.

name: Build log triage
description: A proposed parser that groups build failures by likely root cause.
scope: Log truncation, secret redaction, grouped errors, and references to exact lines.

name: Issue similarity
description: A proposed helper for finding possibly related issues without merging them automatically.
scope: Similarity scoring, evidence snippets, and human confirmation before action.

name: Prompt boundary probe
description: A proposed offline test harness for known prompt-injection boundary cases.
scope: Fixture-based inputs, pass/fail criteria, no secret-bearing targets, and reproducible reports.

name: Secret pattern audit
description: A proposed local scanner that flags likely credential strings without printing them.
scope: Allowlisted file types, false-positive controls, masked output, and no external upload.

name: Localization consistency
description: A proposed comparison of translation keys, placeholders, and missing locale entries.
scope: Key-set diff, placeholder matching, source references, and no invented translations.
